subject: Billing identity proofing: portal activation + email copy fallback
messages:
From: Sandy Patel <ap@greenstitch.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Invoice delivery / portal enrollment question

Hi Logan,

Hope you're well — quick question as we're trying to tidy up the AP flows for GreenStitch. We want to opt into your billing portal for structured invoices, but our procurement team requires identity verification for any portal admin accounts (corporate letter + company ID) and that process can take a couple of weeks on our side.

While that's in progress, can Redwood continue to push invoice PDFs to ap@greenstitch.com as a backup? We need the emailed copies to contain full tax breakdowns (VAT line item) and a place for our PO number. Also: will switching to the portal change the invoice numbering or tax fields in a way that would complicate our reconciliation?

I can send our VAT certificate if that helps accelerate anything.

Thanks,
Sandy Patel
AP Manager | GreenStitch Inc.
ap@greenstitch.com
Phone: +1 415 555 2121

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sandy Patel <ap@greenstitch.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / portal enrollment question

Hi Sandy — great question, thanks for outlining the requirements. Short answers: yes, we can continue sending emailed PDF copies as a fallback while your portal admin is being verified; and no, moving to the portal should not change the VAT/tax line treatment or break PO mapping if we capture the same fields.

What we'll do:
- Keep ap@greenstitch.com on the invoice distribution list until you confirm portal activation.
- Provision the portal account once we receive the identity proofing docs you mentioned (company letter on letterhead, VAT certificate, and a government ID for the initial portal admin).
- Send a sample invoice PDF and an XML sample (if you'd like EDI) so your AP team can confirm the fields.

Can you confirm the remit address and whether GreenStitch needs a separate billing contact for AP reconciliation? Also, if you can attach the VAT cert now that will speed the enrollment. I've attached a short checklist and the activation instructions.

Attachments: portal-activation-instructions.pdf (checklist + steps)

Thanks — looping in Marissa from billing ops to own the activation queue and timeline.

Best,
Logan Wright
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
logan_wright@redwood.ai
(510) 555-0184

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sandy Patel <ap@greenstitch.com>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / portal enrollment question

Hi Sandy — Marissa on billing ops here. Thanks for starting the thread. Putting the enrollment checklist in one place and flagging the identity-proofing specifics so your procurement team can prep.

Enrollment checklist (what we'll need from GreenStitch):
1) Company registration document (PDF)
2) VAT certificate (PDF) — mandatory to ensure VAT is displayed correctly
3) Letter on company letterhead authorizing the portal admin
4) Photo ID for the person who will be the initial portal admin (passport or government ID)
5) Confirm remit address and default PO field (i.e., should PO be mapped to invoice header or line-level)

What we do while docs are pending:
- Continue sending PDF invoice copies to ap@greenstitch.com on each billing cycle. These will include the full VAT breakdown and a dedicated PO field in the header if you confirm header mapping.
- Flag your account for priority provisioning once all docs arrive; typical turnaround is 3–5 business days from receipt of complete docs.

Portal behavior notes:
- Invoice numbering remains consistent but the portal will add an internal reference id for search. That won't affect your legal invoice number.
- PDF and structured exports (XML/JSON) will include the same tax fields.
- We can enable automatic PO matching if you provide a sample PO format (attach one if possible).

Attachment: portal-activation-instructions.pdf (detailed steps + screenshots)

If useful, attach a redacted sample PO and I can map the field live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Billing Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

From: Sandy Patel <ap@greenstitch.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Oct 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / portal enrollment question

Hi Marissa — thanks, attaching the VAT cert and a sample PO as requested. A couple quick clarifications:

- Attachment: GreenStitch_VAT_Certificate.pdf (attached)
- Attachment: PO-78932-example.pdf (attached)

Questions:
1) Will emailed PDF copies be redacted in any way (for instance we need to keep bank account info off internal routing copies) or will the full invoice be sent? We need a copy without beneficiary banking details for the internal AP routing team.
2) Once we go live on the portal, can we keep an "email copy" toggle so certain internal reviewers continue to receive a redacted PDF while the portal stores the full invoice?

Thanks,
Sandy
AP Manager | GreenStitch Inc.

From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Sandy Patel <ap@greenstitch.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Oct 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Invoice delivery / portal enrollment question

Hi Sandy — received, thank you. I confirmed Marissa has the VAT cert and your sample PO. Quick answers to your two questions:

1) Emailed copies: We can send two different PDF streams during the migration window — a full invoice to your payments team and a redacted copy (banking fields removed) to your internal AP routing alias. Tell me the redaction rules (e.g., remove bank account & routing numbers, keep tax lines) and we will implement them.

2) Portal email-copy toggle: Yes — the portal supports role-based distribution and an "email-copy" opt-in per recipient. We can enable an automatic redacted copy to a specified alias even after go-live.

Next steps:
- Marissa will provision the portal once she has the signed letter + admin ID (still missing those two).
- I'll add a temporary rule to keep ap@greenstitch.com on the PDF distribution list with redactions applied until you confirm the portal admin is activated.
- I'll also share a sample invoice PDF and XML in a follow-up for your mapping team (HS-128547).

If you can drop the signed letter and admin ID to this thread, we'll start provisioning immediately.

Best regards,
Logan
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachments: portal-activation-instructions.pdf
